rows.en:
(Today's the day of Sheryl's concert
I've been waiting for.)

(All right, time to get fired up and give it
my all!)
(Or so I psyched myself up, but......)
rows.notes: Japanese closes with a half-width bracket; plain parenthesis either way.

rows.en:
(Who'd have thought unknown creatures would
attack the Frontier fleet, and it'd turn right
into my first real combat......)
rows.notes: Japanese indents the second line inside the brackets with a full-width space; indent dropped.
Answers Michel's 'Are you listening?!' (c24366, shared row).

rows.en:
This isn't training!
Space out and you'll get yourself killed!!

rows.notes: Japanese indents the second line inside the brackets with a full-width space; indent dropped. Trails off as in the Japanese.

rows.en: There's only one thing I can tell you......

All right!
Luca, \p, we're heading out!!
Just making it back alive is good enough.

But you'd better look forward to the special
training coming your way.
rows.notes: Ozma's threat of hard training, said with irony.

rows.en:
Not bad for your first real combat.
Keep it up.

(Phew...
I actually made it back alive......)
rows.notes: Japanese indents the second line inside the brackets with a full-width space; indent dropped.

rows.en:
(...Still, what the heck were those things?
In the end, I couldn't even tell what they
were after.)
rows.notes: Japanese indents the second line inside the brackets with a full-width space; indent dropped.

rows.en: (I hope this is the end of the fighting......)
